name: Diyar Nurgozhay
event: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
summary: A Kazakh light heavyweight (12-2; 2-2 UFC; age 30) from the 2024 Contender Series. He entered the UFC 10-0, was submitted in his first two UFC fights (after missing weight in his debut), then rebounded with a decision over Rafael Tobias in March and a R1 TKO of Bruno Lopes at the buzzer in August.

how_they_fight.Striking: The strength. About 4.7 significant strikes a minute at 57%, and 0.9 knockdowns per 15. Against Tobias, teeps and leg kicks kept him at range and his left hand landed repeatedly; Cageside called his counter timing sharp. Knocked Lopes down several times before stopping him at 4:59 of R1 (Yahoo/MMA Junkie).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Two submission wins, both early in his regional career. Wrestles a little (1.3 takedowns per 15) and has reversed bottom position, as he did against Tobias in R2 (Cageside).
how_they_fight.Defense: Both losses came after he was dropped and then submitted: Brendson Ribeiro hit him with a straight right in R1 and kimura'd him in R2, and Uran Satybaldiev dropped him and finished an Ezekiel choke in R1 (Cageside). Tobias took him down, mounted him, and had a Suloev stretch at the horn. Takedown defense around 72%, but the bottom game is a clear weak spot.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Fast finisher. Of nine stoppage wins, eight came in R1 and one in R2. Three decision wins, one over five rounds (Eagle FC 2022). Against Tobias both men tired in R2 and he had to survive a late submission. Both losses were early (R1 and R2).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Has calmed down since his early UFC losses; said 'we figured out a way to move forward' (Sherdog). Grabbed the fence against Tobias without a warning (Cageside).

patterns: Range kickboxing: teeps, leg kicks, left hand
R1 finisher: eight of nine stoppages in R1
concerns: Missed weight by 4.5 lb in his debut (Cageside)
Faces a debutant whose fights almost all end in R1
keys_to_beat: Take him down and attack submissions
Crowd him so he can't use teeps and range
Look for a knockdown to start a scramble

news.text: Booked against Contender Series winner Alik Lorenz for UFC Qatar, per MMA Junkie's sources.
TKO of Bruno Lopes at 4:59 of R1 after several knockdowns.
Said many Kazakh fans gave up on him after his first two UFC losses.
